title: The Naginata Primer
summary: A plain primer teaching the grip and the first sweeping cut of the naginata to an untrained student with no qi.

title: Curved Blade and Shaft Drill-Book
summary: A drill-book of short repeated exercises joining the curved blade to the long shaft for first-year students without qi.

title: A Handbook of the Long Sweep
summary: A short handbook explaining how one long sweeping arc is built from the hips and carried by the shaft.

title: Sweep and Recover Workbook
summary: A workbook of paired exercises that teach a student to swing the naginata and bring it back to guard.

title: Treatise on the Shaft and Edge
summary: A plain treatise on balance and grip placement along the haft for students whose bodies are conditioned to the bone.

title: Lessons on the Blade Heel and Haft Butt
summary: Lessons in close work with the blade heel and the butt cap for students who cannot yet use qi.

title: The Sweeping-Cut Course Book
summary: A course book for students who have awakened their qi and now add light qi to the basic sweeps.

title: A Plain Canon of Curved-Blade Reach
summary: A plain canon setting out reach and distance for the naginata to students who circulate their own qi.

title: Shaft Spin and Hold Exercises
summary: Exercises for spinning and holding the shaft so that a student's qi flows evenly along the whole haft.

title: Naginata Reader for the Circulating Student
summary: A reader that links footwork to the long blade and shows first uses of qi in each stroke.

title: The Wide Arc Student Manual
summary: A student manual for the widest arcs of the naginata and the guards that close each arc safely.
